Have you ever seen paranormal things? It's likely that a demon tried to harass  you. So why does it happen, and what can you do about it? And what about possession? Is there any hope for people who actually have demons controlling them? In this episode, Tim Maddocks, a missionary in Cambodia, shares about how he has to cast demons out of people all the time, and what he's learned about how to be set free. ✉️ Contact Tim: tim@saltmin.org

*Our Mission:* 
It is our hope that a more sophisticated awareness and in-depth knowledge of what lies at the “heart” of 21st century pop culture, will allow families and individuals to more clearly distinguish well-intended, authentic entertainment from deceptively-crafted propaganda, which attacks the minds, confuses the senses, and rips apart the fabric of society.
